annotations.title: Check whether a page answers a search

description: Measures ONE page against a search you name, the same check as the Focus box in the editor. Use it before writing: try a search the page is not set for yet, or send `content` to test a rewrite before saving it. Nothing is written, and the page’s focus stays as it is; write-search-fields sets that. check-page answers for the focus the page already has. Comma-separate several searches to measure each on its own. `state` is answered (one passage carries it), scattered (the words are on the page but never together), barely, missing, or unreadable (the search is in a form this check cannot compare, which says nothing against the page).

content.description: Optional draft body to measure instead of the saved one. Block markup or HTML.

focus.description: The search to measure against. Comma-separate several.

post_id.description: The post or page to measure.

title.description: Optional draft title. An SEO title on the page still wins, because that is what a search result shows.

name: agentimus-check-focus

measured.description: saved or draft: which body this measured.

heading.description: The heading above the best passage, when it has one.

inPassage.description: The most of them found together in one passage.

inTitle.description: How many are in the title a search result shows.

onPage.description: How many are anywhere on the page.

why.description: The reason, in a sentence for the owner.

words.description: How many words of the search were compared.
